guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for all properties in a list of ASE atoms objects from info and calc results
guess_target_metadata: guess whether target samples are per-atom or per-image and if the property is intensive or extensive
check_target_extensive: check if a target property scales extensively with atom count using statistical normalization
check_target_per_atom: check if target samples have a first dimension proportional to the number of atoms
check_uniform_atoms_lengths: check if all structures in a list have the same number of atoms
